title: Temple niche starter kits: six variants as data on lib/sites/kits (coaches, studios, hosts, venues, nonprofits, networks)

source.ref: Mega theme rollout 2026-10-26: Temple niche variants on the Temple block family, the same model as the Midnight kits.

detail: Six kits for the Temple mega theme, one per niche door, each 3 to 4 pages of Temple blocks and shared Space blocks. Pure data on the SiteKit model, loaded lazily by the registry so the public site never imports them. Generic copy in the house voice (docs/marketing/voice-and-language-guide.md), slot tokens for facts a Space already stores, no prices, photos or real names. They appear in the editor's Starter kits panel beside the Midnight kits. Not built here: flipping the picker's feel to live (a test pin needs the owner's words), a Temple feature page.

verify.evidence: Six kits; four tests in lib/sites/kits/temple-variants.test.ts and the shared kit tests pass locally.
